subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read a text about the Internet and answer questions
Find what pronouns and reference words refer to
Use the present simple and present continuous correctly

tf.s: Tim Berners-Lee created the worldwide web in 1991.
tf.why: Yes! He created the worldwide web in 1991.

tf.s: The text describes the Internet as a huge network of linked computers.
tf.why: Right! Millions of computers are linked together.

tf.s: Blogging means writing online to share your thoughts and invite comments.
tf.why: Correct! Readers around the world can comment.

tf.s: We use the present continuous for habits and routines.
tf.why: Habits use the present simple, e.g. 'He e-mails his friends every day.'

tf.s: 'She is texting her friend right now' uses the present continuous.
tf.why: Good! 'is texting' shows an action happening now.

tf.s: 'I am getting a new phone tomorrow' talks about a future arrangement.
tf.why: Yes, the present continuous can show a future plan.

tf.s: Airports and hotels give free connections so that people can stay connected wherever they are.
tf.why: Right! People with laptops can connect to work or home.

tf.s: 'He lives in Sohar' describes a temporary situation.
tf.why: 'Lives' shows a permanent state; 'is living' shows a temporary one.

tf.s: We use pronouns to repeat the same name again and again.
tf.why: Pronouns help us avoid repeating names.

tf.s: The words 'every day' usually go with the present continuous.
tf.why: 'Every day' shows a habit, so we use the present simple.

boxes.q: Which activity is NOT specifically mentioned in the text?
boxes.why: The text mentions shopping, blogging and social networking.

boxes.q: Choose: She ___ her friend right now.

boxes.why: A permanent state uses the present simple.

boxes.q: 'Ali bought a phone. He loves it.' What does 'it' refer to?

boxes.why: Read the sentence before the pronoun to find what it refers to.

boxes.q: Which tense shows a temporary situation?
boxes.why: 'He is living in Sohar this month' is temporary.

boxes.q: What is the Internet described as in the text?
boxes.why: It is the fastest growing technology on the planet.
'Their' refers to the people who read and comment on a blog.

hunt.q: Year the worldwide web was created
Choose: In the kitchen I usually ___.
Choose: but now I ___ the dishes.

o: the computer scientist who created the worldwide web
the owner of a coffee shop
mcq.why: He created the worldwide web in 1991.

mcq.q: What is the present simple used for?
mcq.why: For example: 'He e-mails his friends every day.'

mcq.q: Why do airports, coffee shops and hotels provide free connections?
o: so people can stay connected to work or home wherever they are
to close the Internet at night
mcq.why: Anyone with a laptop or pocket PC can stay connected.

mcq.q: What are 'these services' in the text?

o: I am getting a new phone tomorrow.
I getting a new phone tomorrow.
I gets a new phone tomorrow.
I am get a new phone tomorrow.
mcq.why: The present continuous can show a future arrangement.

mcq.q: Rewrite: 'Tim Berners-Lee invented the web. Tim Berners-Lee was a computer scientist.' Choose the best version.
o: Tim Berners-Lee invented the web. He was a computer scientist.
Tim Berners-Lee invented the web. It was a computer scientist.
Tim Berners-Lee invented the web. They was a computer scientist.
Tim Berners-Lee invented the web. She was a computer scientist.
mcq.why: 'He' replaces the man's name and avoids repetition.

mcq.q: Complete: In the classroom I usually ___ but now I ___.
mcq.why: Habit = present simple; now = present continuous.

mcq.q: What is the difference between 'He lives in Sohar' and 'He is living in Sohar this month'?
o: The first is permanent; the second is temporary
The first is temporary; the second is permanent
mcq.why: The present continuous can show a temporary situation.

mcq.q: In the board game, why do players say a sentence with 'usually' and 'now'?
o: To contrast a habit with an action happening now
mcq.why: 'Usually' goes with the present simple; 'now' goes with the present continuous.

mcq.q: 'Experts predict that it will change our lives.' What does 'it' most likely refer to?
mcq.why: 'It' refers to the technology mentioned before: the Internet.
